title: Some contributions to presheaf model theory, II -- back and forth
summary: We discuss the back and forth technique in the context of presheaf model theory. The essence of the back and forth technique lies in showing the relationship between various hierarchies which calibrate similarity between two models and, more generally, between two pairs consisting of a model and a tuple from it.
